about: The north bank across the Serchu at the mills (tools/town/serchu_mills.py; M2 sprint 12, step 5): `leat` the leat SER-10's stretches, each [x, y, its water z] downstream (`tail` a mill's tail race out of its arch, `race` the last wheel's race to the river); `mills` SER-05 to 08 (`at`, `facing` its front, `level` its floor, `head` its chute's head on the leat, `jet` the chute's foot in its wall, `arch` its tail race's sill); `wheels` the water prayer wheels SER-09.1 and 09.2 (`in` and `out` the leat's water through them); `chutes` (each with the ground under its trestles); `weir` the intake's line of stones out into the river; `bridge` the footbridge SER-11 (`at` its middle over the water, `deck` its level, `facing` the bearing from its south end to its north, each end's place and its crib's height); `lanes` road lanes for tools/terrain/pads.py (the leat's shelf, the tail yards, the path up the south bank SER-11.p, the Yak Road R-09's first legs and landings) and the river's bed cut down where it stood over the water (`channel`); `culverts` where the road passes over the leat; `paths` painted trodden by tools/terrain/control.py; `fields` the barley terraces SER-17 (control.py), `things` hay on them. Regenerated with the terrain.
